question: A train running at 72 km/h crosses a platform in 25 seconds. If the platform is 300 m long, what is the length of the train?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed = 72 km/hr = 20 m/s

⇒ Total distance in 25 sec = 20 × 25 = 500 m

⇒ Train + Platform = 500 m

⇒ Train length = 500 − 300 = 200 m

**∴ Answer = 200 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed = 72 km/hr

Time = 25 sec

Platform length = 300 m

**Formula:**

Speed (m/s) = Speed (km/hr) × 5 ÷ 18

Total distance = Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed = 72 × 5 ÷ 18 = 20 m/s

⇒ Distance covered = 20 × 25 = 500 m

⇒ Train length + Platform length = 500

⇒ Train length = 500 − 300 = 200 m

**∴ Length of train = 200 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Train Crossing Platform:** Total distance = Train length + Platform length

**Speed Conversion:** km/hr to m/s = × 5 ÷ 18

**Basic Formula:** Distance = Speed × Time

**Key Insight:** Crossing platform means full train passes entire platform
